name: PocketBase | Open-Source Backend in One File (Database, Auth, Files, Realtime)
description: SQLite database, auth, file storage, realtime and an admin UI in one Go binary
card_desc: PocketBase: an open-source backend in one file. A realtime SQLite database with a REST API, user auth (password, OTP, OAuth2), file storage and an admin dashboard. Superuser created on first boot, data on a volume.
